And as always, I am wandering in the forest.
Sometimes I remember walking here hand in hand with her but now she's not here, I just don't know why I keep torturing myself like this....

I hear a noise, it's not common to have people at this time of night in the park, I'm ready to draw my gun when then I can appreciate the person. She doesn't look dangerous.

"Excuse me, are you okay? It's not usually a safe place around here."

...

Why did my heart just give a strange hollow when I looked at that person in the eyes?
